title: SEARCH accepts ? as a wildcard for one character

source.quote: A question mark matches any single character; an asterisk matches any sequence of characters.

derivation: "b?x" needs a b, any one character, then x. At position 1 "Big" ends in g, not x. "box" starts at position 9 (B1 i2 g3 space4 r5 e6 d7 space8 b9).
